task_title: Add Obby using shared authored-runtime contracts
overall_assessment: VS-010 implementation is complete and well-executed. All acceptance criteria are met through verification tests and code audit. No new runtime code was required - the existing infrastructure from VS-001, VS-002, and VS-003 already provides all necessary contracts.

obby.json line 116: One win_zone trigger with trigger_type: "win_zone"
